meta.name: alterlab-molecular-dynamics
meta.description: Runs and analyzes molecular dynamics simulations with OpenMM and MDAnalysis — setting up protein and small-molecule systems, assigning force fields, running energy minimization and production MD, and analyzing trajectories (RMSD, RMSF, contact maps, free energy surfaces). Use when simulating protein or ligand dynamics, equilibrating a system, or computing trajectory metrics for structural biology, drug binding, or biophysics. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

howto.what: Claude 可以设置蛋白质和小分子体系、分配力场、运行能量最小化和分子动力学模拟，并分析轨迹（如 RMSD、RMSF、接触图）。
howto.when: 当你需要模拟蛋白质或配体动力学、平衡体系，或计算结构生物学、药物结合、生物物理学的轨迹指标时。

say.text: 帮我用 OpenMM 模拟这个蛋白质的动力学。
say.note: Claude 会准备体系并运行模拟。

say.text: 分析这段轨迹的 RMSD 和 RMSF。
say.note: Claude 会加载轨迹并计算指标。

say.text: 计算蛋白质与配体的接触残基。
say.note: Claude 会分析每帧的接触情况。

howto.what_en: Claude can set up protein and small-molecule systems, assign force fields, run energy minimization and production MD, and analyze trajectories (RMSD, RMSF, contact maps).
howto.when_en: When you need to simulate protein or ligand dynamics, equilibrate a system, or compute trajectory metrics for structural biology, drug binding, or biophysics.

say_en.text: Run an OpenMM simulation for this protein.
say_en.note: Claude will prepare the system and run the simulation.

say_en.text: Compute RMSD and RMSF for this trajectory.
say_en.note: Claude will load the trajectory and compute metrics.
Claude will analyze contacts per frame.
